name: gradient-heading
blurb: Text with a static gradient fill and responsive sizing variants.
description: A flexible heading component with configurable gradient fills, sizes, and font weights. Uses Tailwind utilities and CVA for variant management.
use_when: Headings want a polished gradient appearance without animation.
avoid_when: When animated gradients or other motion effects are needed.
a11y: Text is fully readable via background-clip; uses semantic heading elements.
